items.title: Ingrid Sertso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, August 11, 2014
items.q: She has created adventurous music with Don Cherry, Olatunje, Ornette Coleman, and with her husband, Karl Berger.

ctx.x: Vocalist, poet and teacher Ingrid Sertso was born in Munich, Germany on February 26, 1944. She has created adventurous music with Don Cherry, Olatunje, Ornette Coleman, and with her husband, Karl Berger. She and Karl are co-founders of the Creative Music Studio and were recently honored by the Jazz Journalists Association as “Jazz Heroes.”
Ingrid was interviewed in Woodstock, New York, on August 11, 2014, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
